prompt: From the stern deck of an overloaded Mersey ferry, a crowd of adult silhouettes at the rail in coats with bags, warm deck lights on their backs. Across black water, the Liverpool docks: a row of giant container cranes, booms lifting upright like necks rising, sparks showering where one has pulled a leg off its rail. Behind the port a fuel depot erupts in a dome of orange light that streaks across the water. 35mm. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
